description: What the app collects, once for both stores: Apple's App Privacy and Google Play's Data safety are made from it. Read the app's code first (ploa_privacy_hints). apple: { collects: true|false, types: { <type>: { purposes: [appFunctionality|analytics|personalization|developerAdvertising|thirdPartyAdvertising|other], linked: bool, tracking: bool } } } with types name, email, phone, address, otherContact, health, fitness, payment, credit, otherFinancial, preciseLocation, coarseLocation, sensitiveInfo, contacts, emails, photos, audio, gameplay, support, otherContent, browsingHistory, searchHistory, userId, deviceId, purchaseHistory, productInteraction, advertisingData, otherUsage, crashData, performanceData, otherDiagnostic, environmentScanning, hands, head, otherData. google: { encryptedInTransit, deletionRequest, accountCreation: [usernamePassword|usernameOtherAuth|usernamePasswordOtherAuth|oauth|other] or ["none"], accountCreationOther, accountDeletionUrl (required with accounts) }. Kept in Ploa: Data safety goes to Google with ploa_play_data_safety_send (or the person's Send); App Privacy is entered by the person in App Store Connect.
